svg.text: Invariants: internal deps declared once in [workspace.dependencies]; overflow-checks = true in every workspace (consensus invariant); nested workspaces (◆) build from inside — not reachable by cargo -p from root.
Stack: Rust (nodes, CLI, contracts) + TypeScript (spacekit-js, @spacekit/sdk). AI: Growformer consumed as a pinned Git dependency from the separate spacekit-ai repo (not vendored here).
